name: attune-sense
description: Lets Claude read how you seem right now (calm, tense, tired) from the Attune app on this computer, as gentle guidance, never raw numbers. Attune must be open; camera sensing, sharing and each purpose are allowed by you in Attune.
long_description: Attune is a body-sense companion that runs on your computer. This extension connects Claude Desktop to the running Attune app: Claude can ask for interpreted, number-free context (for example "slow down and check in") for a purpose you have approved, record your corrections and keep short notes if you enabled memory. The extension has no camera or sensing code of its own and cannot grant consent or approve a purpose; only you can, in Attune. If Attune is not running, every tool answers that it is not running and nothing else happens. Non-medical; not a diagnosis.

data_dir.title: Attune data folder (optional)
data_dir.description: Leave empty to use Attune's standard folder. Set it only if you start Attune with a custom ATTUNE_DATA_DIR.

tools.name: get_attune_status
tools.description: Whether Attune is running, what you have allowed in Attune, whether the camera is on and which purposes Claude may use.

tools.name: list_purposes
tools.description: The purposes (lenses) Attune offers and whether you approved each one for Claude.

tools.name: get_body_context
tools.description: Interpreted, number-free guidance for the current reply, through a purpose you approved.

tools.name: record_correction
tools.description: Tell Attune its read was wrong (for example "I'm fine") so it becomes more conservative.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: A short cross-session summary (interpretations only), if you enabled memory in Attune.

tools.name: memory_append
tools.description: Note what mattered this session (no raw signals), if you enabled memory in Attune.
